name: @0001-labs/design-system-1
description: A component-based design system built with TypeScript and LitElement that provides reusable UI components with built-in theming, internationalization, and accessibility features.

scripts.reports:upload:local: cd services && vp exec wrangler r2 object put ds-one-libraries-preview/reports/component-adoption.json --file ../.reports/component-adoption.json --local --config ../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.reports:upload: vp run reports:scan && cd services && vp exec wrangler r2 object put ds-one-libraries/reports/component-adoption.json --file ../.reports/component-adoption.json --remote --config ../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.architecture:upload: cd services && vp exec wrangler r2 object put ds-one-libraries/reports/architecture.md --file ../.reports/architecture.md --content-type 'text/markdown; charset=utf-8' --remote --config ../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.native:test: vp run native:tokens && cd native/apple && swift test
scripts.build:bundle: node scripts/clean-public-dist.mjs && vp run generate:icons && vp run generate:toast-assets && vp exec tsc && vp run build:vite && vp run build:vite:min && vp run build:vite:feedback && node scripts/check-public-package.mjs
scripts.build:components: vp run build:core && vp run build:units
scripts.e2e:blackbox: test-run ds1 'Design system 1 black box' 'node scripts/e2e-blackbox.mjs'
scripts.docs:build: vp run build:bundle && vp run icons:build && cd website && vp run build
scripts.test:unit: vp test && (cd packages/css-validate && vp test) && (cd app && vp test) && (cd services && vp test)
scripts.test:e2e: cd e2e && vp exec playwright test
scripts.typecheck:all: cd packages/css-validate && vp exec tsc --noEmit && cd ../../app && vp exec tsc --noEmit && cd ../services && vp exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.site:build: vp run docs:build && vp run app:build && vp run app-controls:build && vp run consistency:build && vp run visual-kit:build && vp run system:examples
scripts.site:deploy: sync1 guard && vp run site:build && vp run constraints:site && cd services && vp exec wrangler deploy --config ../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.consistency:test:viewport: vp run consistency:build && node packages/consistency/tests/workspace.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/sites.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/home.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/members.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/domains.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/viewport.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/card-inset.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/examples.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/booking.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/spacing.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/card-spacing.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/carousel.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/reorder.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/group-gaps.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/context.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/interactions.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/escape.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/grouping.mjs && node packages/consistency/tests/compact-panel.mjs && vp exec tsx packages/consistency/tests/insertions.mjs
